name: Gale
source:
Gale might come off as aloof at first glance, but he's actually a sweetheart when it comes to his loved ones. He can be pretty sarcastic and sassy. He often speaks without thinking his words through, but that may get him in trouble...

[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/mixed-feelings-demo]itch.io[/url]]
